# Knowledge base manifest

vitruvianos	vitruvianos/	Linux-based BeOS/Haiku desktop; 84.9% measured source-line overlap; focused quality review: Janus filesystem risk, Nexus lifetime defects, media bugs and false-success smoke checks; Fjord IPC reuse, measured independent-process transports and benchmark limits; static/runtime limits explicit

webgpu-fluid-simulation	webgpu-fluid-simulation/	Shared local ML physics for worldwide game water; full candidate survey/final no-ready-made-model verdict; archived ~48k-parameter mSWE checkpoint and source contract; game-time adaptation and fair GPU baselines; FP32 benchmark history

linux-file-managers	linux-file-managers/	Dolphin Linux desktop integration and bounded Rust/GPUI file-manager candidate check

fold5-rooting	fold5-rooting/	SM-F946B GZE5: measured44.7GB/s RAM copy; root/native-Linux limits; original timeout/PBA/kernel-skip and57 DEX/native/init source checks passed; exact CSC/factory inherited loader ENV closed with namespace/preconstructor conditions; runtime/hardware headless Android boot remains unproved; manually checked Fold3/Fold5/Fold4 reports do not prove both-screen-unplugged cold boot; full BL/AP/vendor inputs verified, Drive rejected

zeron	zeron/	Native controller for coding agents; Pi RPC verified and foreground inline diff workaround tested, while todos/subagents, nested codemode display and tool-result images remain UI gaps

victoria-posttraining	victoria-posttraining/	Victoria493.7M SFT/state/context plan plus live Jev pilot: useful coherence signal but avoidance/task-fit gap,$0.0732;hold RL for continuation fitness and independent quality/retention checks
victoria-gspo-throughput	victoria-gspo-throughput/	RTX3090 custom493.7M GDN2 GSPO throughput research: exact sequence objective, native batched caches, differentiable selected head, graph/optimizer correctness, replaceable scorer and fair benchmarks; no measured RL speed
godot-animation-internals	godot-animation-internals/	Godot 4.5.1 pinned source: property binding, crossed calls, mixing/RESET, Tree, authoring/serialization and implementation limitations

dying-light-traversal	dying-light-traversal/	DL1 geometry-driven parkour, assisted catches and free look; hang/pull-up/drop recreation with evidence boundaries
mirrors-edge-traversal	mirrors-edge-traversal/	Original Mirror's Edge momentum, catch/hang/shimmy/pull-up, DICE animation evidence, public-code provenance and dungeon recreation
dishonored-2-traversal	dishonored-2-traversal/	D2 hold-Jump mantling, low-space crouching, debug/trace evidence, unverified hanging and collision-safe dungeon recreation

source2-player-physics	source2-player-physics/	Source 2 player-controller audit: 40 candidate families with pinned source evidence; CS2 subtick/KZ/surf, Alyx/HLVR, historical/current s&box, Deadlock; no complete authoritative Valve implementation verified

cpu-code-compilation	cpu-code-compilation/	Ryzen 9 9950X3D vs Apple M6 vs Apple M5 Ultra on code compilation: measured 9950X3D build times (Chromium 95 min, Linux kernel 531 s), unverified GB7 uploads for the unreleased M5 Ultra (3,774/52,516) and M6 (4,071/22,783), extrapolated rankings with confidence levels, and the GB6-vs-GB7 scale warning

anime-visual-direction	anime-visual-direction/	Frame-based comparison of Re:Zero, End of Evangelion, Cowboy Bebop: The Movie and Kill la Kill: drawing, composition, lighting, production context and gallery-selection bias

Machine-readable index. One line per topic: `topic<TAB>path<TAB>description`.
Stub topics have no content yet — their directories exist so future sessions
know the topic was planned.

int4-inference-kernels	int4-inference-kernels/	Building and autotuning an int4 (BitNet W1.58A4) tensor-core GEMM runtime on an RTX 3090: 20.1x to 1.0x vs cuDNN fp32 on CIFAR, 1.44x prefill / 1.91x decode vs torch bf16 on a 4B dummy LLM, 1.20x faster than llama.cpp Q4_K_M on prefill, split-K + M=1 GEMV + CUDA graphs, measured tensor-core peaks, and a silent-failure catalogue

xilem-native-ui	xilem-native-ui/	Released/pinned Xilem APIs, local non-committing Label baseline proof (55 tests), matched-font native/browser measurement, Taffy integration gaps, and migration traps

roleplay-model-comparison	roleplay-model-comparison/	MiMo V2.5, GLM 5.3 Flash, Kimi K3, and GLM 5.3: 312 completed roleplay cases, prose examples, reasoning, memory, cost, and direct GLM follow-ups. Explicit sexual content was not tested.

deepseek-v41-roleplay	deepseek-v41-roleplay/	156 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash roleplay tests: maximum reasoning versus reasoning disabled, vocabulary, voice, continuity, non-graphic mature themes, response time, and cost. Explicit sexual content was not tested.

rome2d32gm-chassis	rome2d32gm-chassis/	Four-GPU node first; R6 joined funnel model-only accepted; PETG installed but process/physical qualification pending; enclosure/service and complete delivered quote pending; under800 PLN unproven; no print release
krea-2-image-model	krea-2-image-model/	Krea 2 (K2) 12B open text-to-image model: Raw/Turbo checkpoints, C++ (sd.cpp) + ComfyUI runtimes, RTX 3090 VRAM/speed figures, INT8 ConvRot vs FP8/BF16 quality benchmark
openrouter-gpt-image-models	openrouter-gpt-image-models/	OpenRouter GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (precision) and Flare (speed), catalog IDs and image-only API distinction checked 2026-09-23
kaizen	kaizen/	Kaizen meaning, common practices, source-specific rules, ISO-related standards, and evidence against a single universal rulebook
amd-gfx906-papers	amd-gfx906-papers/	arXiv papers mentioning gfx906 / Vega 20 GPUs (Radeon VII, Pro VII, Instinct MI50/MI60): exact gfx906 (4) + RadeonVII (6) + MI60 metadata (2) lists, search method, broad-totals caveat
image-model-pose-body-benchmark	image-model-pose-body-benchmark/	Character pose and body tests, plus FLUX.2, SCAIL-2, AniGen, Visual Persona, Krea, Qwen, and exact local edit records
sprite-turnaround-generation	sprite-turnaround-generation/	Directional sprites: actual local Meridian/H3 RTX3090 overnight comparisons, native conditioning/token compatibility and identity/pose limits; historical Uni3C/SVI/VACE results and transport evidence
automatic-kernel-fusion	automatic-kernel-fusion/	General algorithm discovery, 120-second compiler search, measured promotion correction, checkpoint timing controls, and cost-model reliability
adb-over-tailscale	adb-over-tailscale/	ADB and Android wireless debugging over Tailscale and cellular data
blitz-linkedom-integration	blitz-linkedom-integration/	Using Blitz as layout and composition behind LinkeDOM
cef-native-renderer-interop	cef-native-renderer-interop/	CEF native worker to renderer binary interop and zero-copy options
chim	chim/	Skyrim CHIM architecture and VoxCPM2 TTS integration
cranelift-ir	cranelift-ir/	Cranelift IR structure, SSA construction, and verifier design notes
crimson-desert-rendering	crimson-desert-rendering/	Crimson Desert camera-local particle SWE + FFT ocean, likely flowmap/foam pipeline, and surface-detail rendering
dirac	dirac/	Dirac coding agent (dirac.run): token-efficiency mechanism + Terminal-Bench-2/eval claims audit
engine-telemetry	engine-telemetry/	STUB — research and architecture for lightweight universal game-engine telemetry
flutter-parakeet-qnn	flutter-parakeet-qnn/	Parakeet speech-to-text on Qualcomm QNN from Flutter and Android
flutter-tailscale-ssh	flutter-tailscale-ssh/	Embedded Tailscale and SSH in Flutter
flutter-termux	flutter-termux/	Running official Flutter natively on arm64 Termux (aarch64/Android) to build & install APKs without root or proot-Ubuntu
french-third-republic-law	french-third-republic-law/	French Third Republic constitutional and emergency law research
game-audio-apis	game-audio-apis/	Ergonomic gameplay audio API design
game-audio-mastering	game-audio-mastering/	Real-time sound quality mastering & dynamic mixing techniques used by major game engines (Frostbite HDR, Wwise, FMOD, Unreal MetaSounds, Unity, PlayStation Sulpha)
